hypothesis.statement: The PPG (PLETH) pulse rate agrees with the simultaneous ECG (lead II) heart rate on BIDMC record bidmc01 (mean pulse rate within a few bpm of the ECG gold standard).

analysis_plan.dataset: BIDMC record bidmc01 (PhysioNet), PLETH + II @ 125 Hz, ~8 min ICU recording

decision.threshold: descriptive: PPG mean pulse rate vs ECG heart rate; |PPG - ECG| within a few bpm
